heroSummary: Tacoma Public Schools began the 2025–26 student year on Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Kindergarten started Monday, September 8, and the one-hour Wednesday late-start routine began September 10. The scheduled last day was Wednesday, June 17, 2026, with early release; June 18 and June 22 were listed as snow make-up days if needed.
calendarNotes: The revised TPS calendar distinguishes full no-school dates from conference early releases and from grade-specific closures. Elementary students had a trimester break on December 5, while secondary students had a semester break on January 30. Snow make-up dates required district confirmation before families could treat them as attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Tacoma Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–12 started Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Kindergarten students started Monday, September 8.

calendarFaqs.q: When did TPS Wednesday late starts begin in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The one-hour Wednesday late-start schedule began September 10, 2025. The page marks the start of the recurring routine rather than listing every Wednesday.

calendarFaqs.q: When was TPS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. School resumed Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Did every TPS student have December 5 and January 30 off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. December 5 was an Elementary Trimester Break for elementary students only. January 30 was a Secondary Semester Break for secondary students only.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of Tacoma Public Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day was Wednesday, June 17, 2026, with early release. June 18 and June 22 were listed as snow make-up days if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: Were the TPS snow make-up dates automatic school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. They were reserved for weather make-up use. Families needed to check TPS announcements to learn whether a date was activated.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 7, 2026, against the official TPS 2025–26 student calendar PDF revised April 7, 2025.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified the grades 1–12 and kindergarten opening dates, the start of weekly Wednesday late starts, full no-school dates, conference early releases, grade-specific academic breaks, major school breaks, and the scheduled last day.
December 1 and April 13 are the next scheduled student weekdays after the published Thanksgiving and Spring Break ranges. January 5 is explicitly labeled as the date school resumes.

The PDF labels February 13 and May 22 as snow make-up days and labels June 18 and June 22 as snow make-up days if needed. This page treats all four as conditional and advises families to confirm activation with TPS.
The downloadable calendar is a one-time file and does not reproduce every weekly Wednesday late start or update automatically after a district revision.
